hero.title: High-Quality Fly Ash Bricks for Strong & Sustainable Construction
hero.desc: Built for load-bearing strength and certified durability. Our eco-friendly fly ash bricks offer superior heat insulation, uniform dimensions, and cost savings up to 20% on mortar.

about.subtitle: Who We Are
about.title: Redefining Industrial Brick Manufacturing Standards
about.text: At Meenakshi Flyash Bricks, we manufacture premium fly ash bricks using automated hydraulic press systems. Our mission is to produce building materials that exceed Indian Standards (IS 12894) while preserving nature by recycling fly ash.

products.subtitle: Our Offerings
products.title: Engineered For Heavy Load Structures
products.desc: From standard walls to load-bearing columns and eco-friendly paving, explore our heavy-duty product lineup.
products.p1_desc: Designed for internal partitions, external load-bearing masonry walls, and framed structures.
products.p2_desc: High precision tongue-and-groove brick layout that speeds up building time and eliminates mortar needs.
products.p3_desc: Ideal for high-traffic environments, factory floors, shipping yards, pathways, and villa driveways.

cta.title: Build Stronger. Save Cost. Go Green.
cta.desc: Consult with our structural engineering team today to receive a detailed cost-comparison breakdown against traditional red clay bricks.
